title: Canned Coconut Milk vs Coconut Beverage: Not the Same Food

seo.title: Canned Coconut Milk vs Coconut Beverage
seo.meta_description: Full-fat canned coconut milk often has 150–200 calories and 15–20 g fat per 100 g; unsweetened coconut beverage can have only 15–30 calories and very little protein.
seo.search_intent: Distinguish canned coconut milk from coconut beverage by concentration, calories, fat, and protein.

excerpt: Canned coconut milk is a concentrated, fat-rich cooking ingredient. Coconut beverage is heavily diluted with water: unsweetened versions may have only 15–30 calories per 100 mL and usually very little protein.
content_html:
“Coconut milk” can describe two products that are nutritionally worlds apart. Canned coconut milk is a concentrated cooking ingredient; refrigerated coconut beverage is mostly water and can contain a tenth as many calories.

Canned coconut milk is much more concentrated

Full-fat canned coconut milk commonly provides roughly 150–200 calories and 15–20 g of fat per 100 g. Unsweetened coconut beverage may provide only about 15–30 calories and 1–3 g of fat per 100 mL.

Coconut beverage is also very low in protein

Many cartons contain less than 1 g of protein per cup or per 100 mL depending on brand. Calcium and vitamin D may be added, so fortification can improve micronutrients without making it a protein equivalent to dairy or soy milk.

Recipes feel the concentration difference

Curry, soup, and dessert recipes often rely on the fat and solids in canned coconut milk. A drinking beverage can make the same recipe watery and less rich.

Separation in the can is normal

Fat-rich coconut solids can rise and form a firm layer in a cool can. Stirring or warming recombines them. In beverage cartons, stabilizers help keep the product uniform.

The practical distinction

Use canned coconut milk when a recipe needs coconut fat and body. Treat coconut beverage as a drink and compare its protein, added sugar, and fortification with other milk alternatives.

faq.question: Can coconut beverage be used in curry?
faq.answer: It can, but the sauce will be much thinner and less rich than with full-fat canned coconut milk.

faq.question: Which has more calories?
faq.answer: Full-fat canned coconut milk, usually by a very large margin.

faq.question: Is coconut beverage high in protein?
faq.answer: Usually not. Many products contain very little protein even when fortified with calcium or vitamin D.
